instruction: A candid outdoor photograph in a medium full shot captures a couple on a sunny sandy beach with ocean waves and a clear blue sky in the background. On the left, the man in the grey t-shirt and khaki pants (R2) walks forward, looking towards his partner with a warm smile. On the right, the woman in the lavender crop top and denim shorts (R1) walks alongside him, smiling back at him. They walk side-by-side, holding hands with his left hand clasped in her right hand. The scene is illuminated by bright, direct sunlight, casting soft shadows on the sand and highlighting the warm, natural tones of the beach.
